columnTypes.timestamps: ISO-8601 text preserved from the owner publication

sourceRules.governance: singleton persistence authority -> active batch -> orgmaster-governance.v3.json
sourceRules.receipt: applied orgmaster.governance-command-receipt.v2 with its existing complete financialCatalogActivation proof
sourceRules.checkpoint: proof.fmsCheckpoint must already contain fms.governance-checkpoint.v1, an fms.governance-intent.v1 intent for the exact FMS application/company, and an explicit null receipt; legacy receipts receive no fabricated checkpoint
sourceRules.identity: checkpoint Employee and intent Principal match the proof; intent operationId equals the original Org commandId; FMS selects only the original Principal and operation
sourceRules.intent: catalog, preview and expected governance/assignment/catalog-binding/grant revisions match the persisted activation proof
sourceRules.audit: exact auditReference and commandId, financial_catalog_activate action, financialCatalogRelease entity, actor Principal and catalog version
sourceRules.publication: historical assignment-governance-v3 publication matches assignmentVersionAfter, snapshot hash, publisher Principal, governance revision and receipt timestamps; its FMS catalog matches the proof
sourceRules.source: receipt source is proof.fmsCheckpoint.source; binding source is selected by the adapter server configuration and is not a view column
sourceRules.binding: activePolicyVersionId -> assignment-governance-v3 -> valid FMS application-contract catalog; catalog_binding_revision is contentSha256 and governance_revision is the artifact canonical SHA
sourceRules.auditAfterHash: FMS adapter verifies orgmaster.sorted-json.v1 SHA-256 over {requestHash: org_request_hash, previewHash: preview_hash, record: proof}; SQL projects the stored audit hash without recomputing it
